findings.title: Java MessageFormat syntax in an i18next bundle breaks interpolation in the account console
findings.body:
The account console renders this bundle with i18next. Its placeholders use `{{0}}`, as every other `error-*` key in this file still does, and server errors are passed as `t(errorMessage, {0:..,1:..,2:..})`.

The new value uses `{0}`, `{1}`, `{2}` and `{2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}`. i18next interpolates none of these, so users will see the literal text "Attribute {0} must have at least {1} and at most {2} {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}."

The old `{{0}}` value already passed the new verifier, because the `<!-- -->` stripping handles it, so the change was not required. Keep `{{n}}` placeholders here and use i18next pluralization instead of ChoiceFormat.

findings.title: Admin console message switched to MessageFormat syntax that i18next won't interpolate
findings.body: The admin console (keycloak.v2) also uses i18next with `{{param}}` interpolation. Replacing `{{0}}/{{1}}/{{2}} value(s)` with `{0} ... {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}` means the user-profile multivalued-size validation error appears with raw `{0}` placeholders and the choice pattern visible. Revert to `{{n}}` placeholders or use i18next plural keys.

findings.title: Prefix/suffix trimming can overlap and throw StringIndexOutOfBoundsException
findings.body: The `end` loop is bounded only by the string lengths, not by `length - start`. When the common prefix and common suffix overlap in the shorter string, `sanitized.substring(start, sanitized.length() - end)` (or the `value` substring) is called with begin > end and throws. Example: a translation containing a duplicated closing tag such as `{0}`. The sanitizer drops the orphan ``, so start=10 and end=4 on a 10-char string, giving substring(10, 6). The consequence is that the maven plugin crashes with a stack trace instead of reporting "Illegal HTML in key ..." for exactly the kind of broken markup it is meant to catch. Bound the suffix loop with `end < sanitized.length() - start && end < value.length() - start`.

findings.title: Anchor mismatch message omits key and file
findings.body:
`messages.add("Didn't find anchor tag " + matcher.group() + " in original string")` does not include the file or the key. The `key` parameter is passed into `santizeAnchors` but never used.

The verifier runs over hundreds of property files, so a build failure with this message gives no way to find the offending translation. Include `key` and `file` the same way the "Illegal HTML" message does.

findings.title: Missing English counterpart crashes the plugin with a RuntimeException
findings.body:
The English file path is guessed with two regex replacements. The `_[a-zA-Z-_]*\.properties` pattern also swallows any earlier underscore-separated segment of the file name, so `my_messages_de.properties` resolves to `my_en.properties`.

If the guessed file does not exist, a `RuntimeException` is thrown. `verify()` only catches `IOException`, so this escapes as an unhandled exception rather than a `MojoExecutionException` or a reported message. Any community bundle without an exactly mirrored `_en` file in `resources` aborts the build with an unclear stack trace.

Fall back to an empty English bundle and add a message, or wrap the error in `MojoExecutionException`.

findings.body: `santizeAnchors` removes each translated `` or `` that matches the next English anchor, and only the remainder is sanitized. Two problems follow. 1. A translation that keeps `` but drops the closing `` passes silently. The page or email then renders an unclosed link that swallows the following content. The sanitizer would normally detect this imbalance, but it never sees the anchor. 2. findings.title: Lithuanian totpStep1 replaced with Italian text
findings.body: The Lithuanian translation of `totpStep1` was replaced with "Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:", which is Italian. Lithuanian users of the account theme will see an Italian sentence on the OTP setup page. It should be Lithuanian, for example "Įdiekite vieną iš šių programėlių savo mobiliajame telefone:".

findings.title: Lithuanian loginTotpStep1 replaced with Italian text
findings.body: The Lithuanian `loginTotpStep1` is now "Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:", which is Italian, apparently copied from the Italian bundle. Lithuanian users will see Italian text on the login OTP configuration page. Provide a Lithuanian translation, or remove the key so it falls back to English.

findings.title: Traditional Chinese text added to the Simplified Chinese bundle
findings.body: The new `totpStep1` value "在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：" uses Traditional characters (手機, 安裝, 應用程式) in the zh_CN (Simplified) file. It should be Simplified, for example "在您的手机上安装以下应用程序之一：", consistent with the zh_CN login bundle.

findings.title: No tests confirm valid translations produce no messages
findings.body:
All new tests only assert that some error is reported. There is no fixture where a translation has allowed tags (``, `

The verifier relies on fragile normalization: entity unescaping, `` stripping, choice-format and RTL-style special cases. False positives that would break the theme build are therefore not covered.
